mapper.insert: INSERT INTO g5_board_file(bo_table, wr_id, bf_source, bf_file, bf_fileurl, bf_download, bf_content, bf_filesize, bf_type, bf_datetime) VALUES (#{boTable}, #{wrId}, #{bfSource}, #{bfFile}, #{bfFileUrl}, 0, "", #{bfFilesize}, #{bfType}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT bo_table, wr_id, bf_file, bf_fileurl FROM g5_board_file WHERE wr_id = #{wrId} AND bo_table = #{boTable}
mapper.update: UPDATE g5_board_file SET bf_source = #{bfSource}, bf_file = #{bfFile}, bf_fileurl = #{bfFileUrl}, bf_filesize = #{bfFilesize}, bf_type = #{bfType}, bf_datetime = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE bo_table = #{boTable} AND wr_id = #{wrId}
